name: Eldarin Tree

notes: A great and sacred tree revered by the Navi.
One of the largest and most sacred magical locations in Atlas.
Many such trees once existed historically, but only one remains in the present.
Its rings inspired the design and creation of the keystones.
The Mother's Prayer is connected to this tree, with chosen individuals metaphorically described as fruit plucked from it.
A sacred and ancient tree revered by the Navi.
Its rings inspired the design and creation of the keystones.
Its study ultimately led to the creation of the keystones and the beginning of the Mother's Prayer.

openQuestions: Why is only one Eldarin Tree believed to remain?
What is the true nature and origin of the Eldarin Tree?
